title: Khadamat Hub - Marketing Agency Website
description: A modern and professional website for Khadamat Hub marketing agency, showcasing their services, portfolio, and client testimonials with an elegant design.
content:
Developed a comprehensive marketing agency website for Khadamat Hub featuring:
- Modern and responsive design
- Services showcase section
- Portfolio gallery with filtering
- Client testimonials and reviews
- Contact form with validation
- Multi-language support (Arabic & English)
- SEO optimized
- Fast loading performance
- Admin dashboard for content management

title: CV Portfolio Builder for Developers
description: An interactive CV and portfolio website builder specifically designed for developers and programmers to showcase their skills, projects, and experience.
content:
Created a dynamic CV/Portfolio platform for developers featuring:
- Professional CV templates
- Interactive project showcase
- Skills visualization with progress bars
- Blog section for technical articles
- Contact form integration
- Multi-language support (Arabic, English, French)
- Dark/Light mode toggle
- Downloadable PDF CV
- Admin panel for content management
- Authentication system
- Responsive design for all devices

title: ShopCart - E-Commerce Platform
description: A full-featured e-commerce platform with product management, shopping cart, payment integration, and order tracking system.
content:
Built a comprehensive e-commerce solution featuring:
- Product catalog with categories and filtering
- Advanced search functionality
- Shopping cart with quantity management
- Secure checkout process
- Payment gateway integration (Stripe/PayPal)
- Order tracking and history
- User authentication and profiles
- Wishlist functionality
- Product reviews and ratings
- Admin dashboard for:
  - Product management
  - Order management
  - User management
  - Sales analytics
- Responsive design
- Real-time inventory updates

title: Infinity Learning Academy - Online Courses Platform
description: A comprehensive Learning Management System (LMS) for Infinity Learning Academy, offering online courses, video lectures, quizzes, and student progress tracking.
content:
Developed a feature-rich learning management system including:
- Course catalog with categories
- Video streaming integration
- Interactive quizzes and assignments
- Student progress tracking
- Certificate generation upon completion
- Discussion forums for each course
- Live chat support
- Payment integration for course enrollment
- Instructor dashboard for:
  - Course creation and management
  - Student analytics
  - Content upload (videos, PDFs, resources)
  - Grade management
- Student dashboard with:
  - Enrolled courses
  - Progress tracking
  - Certificates
  - Learning history
- Admin panel for platform management
- Responsive design
- Multi-language support
